item.title: About
item.description: I am an entrepreneur & tech leader. I love technology, and have led teams in emerging fields such as artificial intelligence, machine learning, fintech, blockchain, devsecops, backend, and mobile apps. I am available as a technology and business mentor, as a board member or advisor, and occasionally enjoy publishing educational or thought-provoking video and written content. I am also a huge advocate of net-neutrality, I love to travel, I am an amateur radio operator, and proudly served as a volunteer EMT responding to 911 medical emergencies.
